integrity: The previously published nonequivariant wedge-of-spheres formula is used as an explicit cited premise and is not presented as novel. Exact finite character checks accompany an independent symbolic proof of the all-parameter exchange formula.
scientific_limitations: Uniform formula only for the canonical bipartition exchange; all conjugacy classes computed only for K_{4,4}; rational characters do not determine an integral G-lattice or equivariant homotopy type.
title: Equivariant top homology of balanced complete-bipartite Morse complexes
